narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Arizona produce showers and thunderstorms. One storm produce heavy rain over the Verde Valley which flowed into the Verde River.
ev: USGS stream gauge on the Verde River near Camp Verde (VAVA3) reported a 1.26 foot rise from earlier thunderstorms upstream at 745 PM. Another gauge downstream (VCVA3) started to rise at 200 AM, peaked at 600 AM (just under a one foot rise), and then returned to near normal at 600 AM on July 19.
